messages:
Lucy: Hey team — quick microcopy review. We’ve got a tooltip on the global shortcut in the top nav that currently shows: `Open Console — Ctrl+K`. UX wants to show the shortcut for Mac too, but also keep it short. Thoughts?

Mike: I vote for `Open Console (Ctrl/Cmd+K)` — concise and familiar.

Ana: 👍 but small screens will clip parens. Can we move the shortcut into the tooltip body instead of inline label?

Lucy: Good point. Current layout is label + small grey shortcut to the right. On mobile the right side is hidden so people never see it.

Jorge: From an implementation angle we render the shortcut element separately so moving it to the tooltip is easy. But accessibility note: screen readers will read things in order; if we put `Ctrl/Cmd+K` verbatim it might be confusing unless we provide an aria-label that expands it.

Lucy: Proposal A: Keep visible label `Open Console` and tooltip body: `Press Control (Windows/Linux) or Command (Mac) + K to open the console` — maybe shorter?

Mike: That's clearer for a keyboard-first person. But feels long for a tooltip. Maybe lean on the visible label for brevity and tooltip for expansion.

Jorge: For aria we should set `aria-describedby` to a hidden element with text: `Press Control or Command and K to open Console` so SRs get the full sentence. Tooltip can be shorter: `Shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd + K`

Ana: Can we standardize the delimiter? `Ctrl/Cmd + K` vs `Ctrl/Cmd+K` — choose one. I prefer spaces around + for readability.

Design-Lead: Accessibility trumps terseness here. Recommend: visible: `Open Console` (no shortcut), tooltip: `Shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd + K — opens console` and add an `aria-label` on the button: `Open Console (press Control or Command and K)`

Lucy: Draft copy for tooltip (v1):
```
Shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd + K
Press to open the Console
```

Lucy: Draft copy for sr-only aria description (v1): `Press Control or Command and K to open the Console`

Mike: I like that split. Keeps UI clean, tooltip concise, SR gets the sentence. Also add link to Keyboard shortcuts page? Maybe `Learn more: Settings → Shortcuts` but that's extra.

Jorge: Implementation note: if we include the link, make it tabbable and only in the tooltip body, not in the aria description. Screen reader users will rely on the aria text and the shortcuts page link should be accessible from the menu.

a11y-bot: a11y-bot check — recommended: use `aria-label` for the control OR `aria-describedby` pointing to an element with the expanded sentence. Ensure `role=\"button\"` and keyboard focus visible. Also prefer wording: "Press Control or Command and K" over "Ctrl/Cmd + K" in aria text.

Ana: Minor nit — localize `Control` vs `Ctrl`? For translations, use full words in aria, abbreviations in visual.

Lucy: Final ask: pick one short tooltip string and one aria string. I can update figma and handoff.

Design-Lead: Tooltip (final): `Shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd + K`
Aria (final): `Press Control or Command and K to open the Console`

Mike: Approved. Lucy can you update the component docs with the ARIA pattern? :thumbsup:

Lucy: Will do — will push Figma and add example in the component README with the `aria-describedby` snippet. Thanks!
